\textit{How to use these questions.} Answer without consulting the notes,
then check against the cited section. Give complete hypotheses when stating
a result. Justify examples and counterexamples. Proof questions concentrate
on the arguments developed in the chapter; other results are primarily
tested through statements and applications. No solutions are included.

Unless specified otherwise, all sets are subsets of \(\R\), and openness,
closedness, limits, and compactness are taken in \(\R\).
Use \(\N=\{1,2,3,\ldots\}\).
